summary: Here is a charming and spacious village property in Knayton, near Thirsk, offering a blend of character features and modern comfort. With well-proportioned living spaces, generous bedrooms, and private outdoor areas, it provides ideal accommodation for those seeking a peaceful rural lifestyle while remaining close to local amenities and transport links.
description: Here is an attractive and characterful property set in the peaceful village of Knayton, just a short distance from the market town of Thirsk in North Yorkshire. Combining traditional charm with comfortable living, the home offers a spacious and versatile layout ideal for families or those seeking a quieter rural lifestyle. The property features well-proportioned reception rooms filled with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. A thoughtfully designed kitchen provides ample storage and workspace, suitable for both everyday living and entertaining. Bedrooms are generously sized, offering comfortable accommodation, while the bathrooms are finished to a practical standard. Externally, Chapel House benefits from private outdoor space, perfect for relaxing or enjoying the surrounding countryside setting. The property may also include off-street parking and garden areas, enhancing its appeal for long-term tenants. Located in a desirable rural setting, Knayton offers a strong sense of community while remaining conveniently close to Thirsk, where a range of shops, schools, and transport links can be found. With easy access to the wider North Yorkshire countryside, this property is ideal for those looking to balance tranquillity with accessibility.
